notes:
TCC Website Features 0.2.1: a smarter website search, and a Search tab

Search now knows words that mean the same: a search for "kids" also finds
"children" and "nursery". The list is under TCC Website > Search and can be
changed there.

The same tab lists what visitors searched for and could not find, so a missing
page or a missing word can be spotted. Only the words are kept.

A word now matches only where a word starts ("men" finds "Men's Ministry", not
"moment"), and community groups marked as not active are left out.
